The report says six of 47 counties (Grade D, scores under 40%) rely heavily on manual and cash-based systems.
The paper (European Scientific Journal, September 2020) says 33 of the 47 county governments had automated their revenues, though some only partially and with structured revenue streams still manual.

fact: On 7 February 2019 the President directed a multi-agency task force to deliver one Integrated County Revenue Management System (ICRMS) for all 47 counties; the paper reports no delivery by September 2020.

The CEG Kenya policy brief (imprint 2018, no event date) says 34 of the 47 counties had acquired revenue management systems from various vendors, and 97 per cent of those 34 used only the revenue collection module.
